cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The model was fine-tuned on question-answer examples built from actual Kenyan legal and regulatory source documents (Acts, tax code, social security law) and carries a digest of verified compliance facts in its GGUF chat template, making complex compliance requirements accessible to small business owners who cannot afford professional legal or tax counsel. An optional application in this repository (rag_server.py) additionally retrieves passages from a corpus of those documents (retrieval-augmented generation), but the GGUF itself does not depend on it.

test_prompts.prompt: What are the NSSF contribution rates for an employee earning KSh 30,000 per month?
What are the basic steps to register a small business in Kenya?
